title: Symmetry of statistical distance
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, and let $p$ and $q$ be probability distributions on $\Omega$. Their statistical distance is symmetric: $d_{\mathrm{stat}}(p,q)=d_{\mathrm{stat}}(q,p)$.
